note: The only browser the renderer draws with: Chrome for Testing's headless shell, put into the container image by its build, pinned by version and by the sha256 of the archive. For each architecture: the archive's URL, its size and md5 (read on 2026-10-13 from the object metadata of the official storage bucket, https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/chrome-for-testing-public/o/<path>) and its sha256. Chrome for Testing publishes no sha256, so it is null until the maintainer runs `ffmpeg.py pin-browser --confirmed`, which downloads the archive once, checks size and md5 against the published values and records the sha256 here; `build` refuses while it is null, and the image's build refuses an archive that differs from any of the three. The version is the Stable channel of https://googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing/last-known-good-versions-with-downloads.json read on 2026-10-13.
